queries:
SELECT AVG(avg_mem) FROM (SELECT AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_mem FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE p.memusagegb > 60.8 GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat)
SELECT AVG(avg_mem) FROM (SELECT flowsoft, AVG(memusagegb) AS avg_mem FROM scanprocessing WHERE memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY flowsoft);
SELECT s.entrystat, AVG(p.flowhrs) AS avg_flowhrs
FROM scanprocessing p
JOIN sites s ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
WHERE p.memusagegb > 60.8
GROUP BY s.entrystat;
SELECT entrystat, AVG(scan_cnt) AS avg_scans_per_site
FROM (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, COUNT(sc.questregistry) AS scan_cnt
  FROM sites s
  LEFT JOIN scans sc ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
)
GROUP BY entrystat;
SELECT flowsoft, AVG(CAST(procgpu AS REAL) / proccpu) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio
FROM scanprocessing
WHERE proccpu IS NOT NULL AND proccpu <> 0 AND procgpu IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY flowsoft;
SELECT flowsoft, AVG(procgpu) * 1.0 / AVG(proccpu) AS gpu_cpu_ratio
FROM scanprocessing
GROUP BY flowsoft;
